exact_reduction.anti_invariant_y: Target Y has the form Y=w*H with H in K(C).
exact_reduction.critical_profile: The three Q points are exactly the C-points whose two lifts ramify f with index 2. For X:C->P1, a Q has local degree 2 if its critical value is non-special and local degree 4 if its critical value is one of {0,1,lambda,infinity}. All other critical points of X are ordinary double points in special fibers. If s of the three Q have special critical values, the special fibers contribute 9+s to the X ramification divisor and the remaining Q contribute 3-s, totaling 12 as required by Riemann-Hurwitz.
exact_reduction.descended_x: X=x∘f lies in K(C), and deg(X:C->P1)=6.
exact_reduction.double_cover: pi:D->C is w^2=(R+2)t with involution iota(w)=-w.
exact_reduction.fiber_product_identity: A*X*(X-1)*(X-lambda)=(R+2)*t*H^2 for a nonzero target twist constant A.
exact_reduction.normalized_equivariance: For any candidate f with f^*omega_E=c*phi, after target translation one may normalize f∘iota=[-1]∘f.
exact_reduction.phi_zero_divisor: phi has six simple zeros: the two lifts to D of each of the three distinct points Q on C satisfying t=-k.
exact_reduction.q_cubic: The R-coordinates of the Q points satisfy R^3-3R-k^2=0.
exact_reduction.q_cubic_discriminant: disc=216*(30*sqrt(6)-73)>0, hence the three Q are distinct.
special_fiber_even_partitions: The six D/C branch points map to the four special x-values in even block sizes.
Ignoring zero blocks, the branch-point block-size patterns are 6; 4+2; or 2+2+2.
A special fiber containing a Q point can contain at most two D/C branch points.
exact_reduction.special_fiber_profile: For a in {0,1,lambda,infinity}, let m=ord_p(X-a) (or pole order at infinity). At p in branch(D/C), m=1 because f is unramified there. At ordinary non-branch p not among Q, m=2 if X(p)=a. If a Q point lies over a special value, then m=4 because f has ramification index 2 and x:E->P1 has ramification index 2 there. Thus parity(m) is odd exactly on branch(D/C).
